Data completeness: full month, real administrative boundary — 3317 recorded incidents for 2026-06, queried against Hillingdon's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for that exact area. Day score: 1.9386 weighted incidents/1,000 people (76% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 10.5352 weighted incidents/1,000 people (83% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 359,432 (2021 resident population of 305,900, scaled by a measured resident-vs-workday ratio from the ONS's 2011 Census release for Hillingdon — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.
